name: Kizaki Haruki
source: Husband of [url=http://vndb.org/c9424]Sae[/url] and father of four girls. He works at a high school which all of his four daughters attend. He's incredibly horny and can't go a day without sex. When his wife leaves him he thinks he'll go crazy.
